title: Dojo NG WebSocket envelope
description: The wire frame WSDispatcher sends and receives, specified independently of the TypeScript types that bind it (src/wsdispatcher.ts's Envelope interface is one binding of this, not the source of truth). The object shape was chosen over a positional array by measuring compressed bytes on the wire; spike/measure-envelope.mjs reproduces the measurement. Every field is always present; there is no undefined-vs-missing distinction on the wire, only JSON-representable values, so this survives JSON.stringify/json.loads round-trips without losing meaning.

action.description: Routes dispatch. "ping" arms the heartbeat watchdog (inbound only). "event" carries a named payload published on pub/sub in either direction. "call" is a correlated request/response, matched by id.

id.description: 0 for "ping" and "event" frames, which aren't correlated. A positive integer for "call", assigned by the caller and echoed back unchanged on the matching response.

data.description: Action-specific payload. Any JSON value for "ping" and "call"; a fixed shape for "event", refined below.

event.description: The pub/sub topic this frame publishes to (inbound) or was published from (outbound).

params.description: The payload delivered to pub/sub subscribers under `event`. Any JSON value.
